thread:
Anya: Quick sync — finalizing launch-post cadence + webinar plan for the tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need copy decisions and an inbound-routing matrix. Short meeting 11:30?
Sam: yes please — also need the benchmark bullets to land in the post. short & punchy.
Leo: Agree. Proposed hero framing: Hosted = fastest time-to-value, Dedicated = predictable throughput, Private = compliance-first. Can we get micro-copy for each?
Marie: I can whip 3 hero variants by EOD. Need one-liners for CTAs: demo, sign-up, contact-sales.
Chris: Landing page should have a tiny technical blurb: quantized models supported, autoscale + burst. Also please confirm the correct /docs link for deployment examples.
Sam: For benchmarks let's call out a real-app case study: ~50ms p99 on Dedicated under steady load; Hosted median ~80ms p50; Private depends on infra. (We should caveat the Hosted p99 variability).
Leo: +1 on caveats. Don’t promise p99 for Hosted — say "low latency at typical workloads". Use conservative phrasing.
Anya: Routing matrix sketch — inbound signals -> target page -> CTA. Example: 1) free trial token usage -> Hosted sign-up; 2) security/compliance questions -> Private contact-sales; 3) sustained throughput requests -> Dedicated contact-sales. Want a simple table for the launch doc.
Marie: I’ll craft CTA microcopy and 3 hero lines. Also adding variant for demo-first vs signup-first CTAs for A/B.
EchoBot: Reminder: Webinar "Serving Inference at Scale" scheduled 2024-11-12 09:00 PT — registration page live.
Sam: Launch posts plan: short social hooks with benchmark highlights, a technical blog with deeper benchmark narrative, and the webinar CTA. Draft hook: "How we cut per-token cost by 40% with KV caching and workload-aware batching." Thoughts?
Anya: Love the hook, Sam. Drop 2–3 more one-liners here and I’ll send to comms.
Marie: Microcopy snippets (drop-in candidates):
```
Hosted Hero: "Get models in prod — minutes to first token."
Dedicated Hero: "Predictable throughput, SLA-backed capacity."
Private Hero: "Control, compliance, and on-prem inference."
CTAs: "Try Hosted (free tier)", "Request Dedicated pricing", "Contact sales for Private"
```
Chris: Docs link to include: https://redwood.example/docs/deploy-guides (please verify path before publish). Also add a tiny code snippet for routing rules in the launch tech appendix: 
```
if inbound_signal == "compliance_check": route -> /private/contact
elif inbound_signal == "spike_estimated_qps": route -> /dedicated/contact
else: route -> /hosted/signup
```
Leo: We should test two hero headlines in the launch GA: "Ship faster with Redwood" vs "Control inference costs". A/B target = CTR to CTA.
Sam: @Marie can you prioritize the Dedicated hero asset? we want a GPU-rack / control-plane visual.
Marie: Yep — swapping in GPU rack photo and a lower-contrast overlay for readability.
Anya: Owner check: Sam = benchmarks/blog, Marie = hero + CTAs, Leo = product copy and promise language, Chris = doc links + tech appendix, Anya = routing matrix + launch calendar. Deliverables: benchmark bullets, 3 hero variants, routing table, webinar copy. Webinar reg -> segment >$500/mo ARR to enterprise follow-up.
Sam: I’ll post the benchmark bullets here by 4pm.
Marie: I’ll upload hero image variants to the drive and ping design-review.
Chris: I’ll confirm docs links and paste final code snippet.
Anya: Great — final convergence by EOD Thurs? If everything landed I’ll schedule the publication calendar and notify comms. :white_check_mark:
